description: Compare two JSON values or two texts without AI. Use this to see exactly what changed between two supplied versions. format json (default): returns added, removed, and changed paths as JSON Pointers; objects compare by key (order ignored), arrays by index (no move detection), and a different type counts as a change. format text: returns line hunks with one-based line numbers, comparing exactly including whitespace and case. Returns canonical SHA-256 hashes (json) or text hashes. Up to 500 changes are returned; counts cover all. Limits: 64 KiB body, 2000 lines per text, 64 nesting levels. Nothing is fetched or retained. A difference is not a judgment of meaning. Same as POST https://bozos.si/api/v1/diff.

after.description: The later version, of the same kind.

before.description: The earlier version: any JSON value, or a string when format is text.

format.description: json compares structure; text compares lines.

name: structuredDiff

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; empty string is the document root.

summary.description: json: changes, added, removed, changed. text: hunks, lines_removed, lines_added, before_lines, after_lines.

title: Compare two JSON values or two texts without AI
